ayahs.tr: Ta, Seen, Meem.
These are the verses of the clear Book.

ayahs.ar: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ اَلَّا يَكُوْنُوْا مُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝٣
ayahs.tr: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.

ayahs.ar: اِنْ نَّشَاْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ اٰيَةً فَظَلَّتْ اَعْنَاقُهُمْ لَهَا خٰضِعِيْنَ ۝٤
ayahs.tr: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَاْتِيْهِمْ مِّنْ ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ الرَّحْمٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ اِلَّا كَانُوْا عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِيْنَ ۝٥
ayahs.tr: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.

ayahs.ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوْا فَسَيَاْتِيْهِمْ اَنۢ͏ْبٰ࢜و͏ٔ͏ُا مَا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ ۝٦
ayahs.tr: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اِلَي الْاَرْضِ كَمْ اَنۢ͏ْبَتْنَا فِيْهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيْمٍ ۝٧
ayahs.tr: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝٨
ayahs.tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذْ نَادٰي رَبُّكَ مُوْسٰٓي اَنِ اي͏ٔ͏ْتِ الْقَوْمَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ ۝١٠ۙ
ayahs.tr: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيْٓ اَخَافُ اَنْ يُّكَذِّبُوْنِ ۝١٢ؕ
ayahs.tr: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me

ayahs.ar: وَيَضِيْقُ صَدْرِيْ وَلَا يَنْطَلِقُ لِسَانِيْ فَاَرْسِلْ اِلٰي هٰرُوْنَ ۝١٣
ayahs.tr: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.

ayahs.ar: وَلَهُمْ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢ͏ْبٌ فَاَخَافُ اَنْ يَّقْتُلُوْنِ ۝١٤ۚۖ
ayahs.tr: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَلَّاۚ فَاذْهَبَا بِاٰيٰتِنَا͏ٓ اِنَّا مَعَكُمْ مُّسْتَمِعُوْنَ ۝١٥
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.

ayahs.ar: فَاْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُوْلَا͏ٓ اِنَّا رَسُوْلُ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۝١٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
[Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِيْنَا وَلِيْدًا وَّلَبِثْتَ فِيْنَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِيْنَ ۝١٨ۙ
ayahs.tr: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?

ayahs.ar: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِيْ فَعَلْتَ وَاَنْتَ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ ۝١٩
ayahs.tr: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَا͏ٓ اِذًا وَّاَنَا مِنَ الضَّا࢜لِّيْنَ ۝٢٠ؕ
ayahs.tr: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.

ayahs.ar: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنْكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِيْ رَبِّيْ حُكْمًا وَّجَعَلَنِيْ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ ۝٢١
ayahs.tr: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.

ayahs.ar: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ اَنْ عَبَّدْتَّ بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَا࢜ءِيْلَ ۝٢٢ؕ
ayahs.tr: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَاؕ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّوْقِنِيْنَ ۝٢٤
ayahs.tr: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
[Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
[Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنَّ رَسُوْلَكُمُ الَّذِيْٓ اُرْسِلَ اِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُوْنٌ ۝٢٧
ayahs.tr: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَاؕ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْقِلُوْنَ ۝٢٨
ayahs.tr: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَىِٕنِ اتَّخَذْتَ اِلٰهًا غَيْرِيْ لَاَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُوْنِيْنَ ۝٢٩
ayahs.tr: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
[Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَاْتِ بِهٖٓ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ ۝٣١
ayahs.tr: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."

ayahs.ar: فَاَلْقٰي عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۝٣٢ۚۖ
ayahs.tr: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.

ayahs.ar: وَّنَزَعَ يَدَهٗ فَاِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَا࢜ءُ لِلنّٰظِرِيْنَ ۝٣٣ࣖ
ayahs.tr: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لِلْمَلَاِ حَوْلَهٗٓ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَسٰحِرٌ عَلِيْمٌ ۝٣٤ۙ
ayahs.tr: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.

ayahs.ar: يُّرِيْدُ اَنْ يُّخْرِجَكُمْ مِّنْ اَرْضِكُمْ بِسِحْرِهٖࣗۖ فَمَاذَا تَاْمُرُوْنَ ۝٣٥
ayahs.tr: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْٓا اَرْجِهْ وَاَخَاهُ وَابْعَثْ فِي الْمَدَا࢜ىِٕنِ حٰشِرِيْنَ ۝٣٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate

ayahs.ar: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ اِنْ كَانُوْا هُمُ الْغٰلِبِيْنَ ۝٤٠
ayahs.tr: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَا࢜ءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوْا لِفِرْعَوْنَ اَىِٕنَّ لَنَا لَاَجْرًا اِنْ كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغٰلِبِيْنَ ۝٤١
ayahs.tr: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَاِنَّكُمْ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِيْنَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.tr: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَهُمْ مُّوْسٰٓي اَلْقُوْا مَا͏ٓ اَنْتُمْ مُّلْقُوْنَ ۝٤٣
ayahs.tr: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."

ayahs.ar: فَاَلْقَوْا حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوْا بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْغٰلِبُوْنَ ۝٤٤
ayahs.tr: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."

ayahs.ar: فَاَلْقٰي مُوْسٰي عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَاْفِكُوْنَ ۝٤٥ۚۖ
ayahs.tr: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].
They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اٰمَنْتُمْ لَهٗ قَبْلَ اَنْ اٰذَنَ لَكُمْۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكَبِيْرُكُمُ الَّذِيْ عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَۚ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ࣢ؕ لَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيْدِيَكُمْ وَاَرْجُلَكُمْ مِّنْ خِلَافٍ وَّلَاُوصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۝٤٩ۚ
ayahs.tr: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا لَا ضَيْرَؗ اِنَّا͏ٓ اِلٰي رَبِّنَا مُنْقَلِبُوْنَ ۝٥٠ۚ
ayahs.tr: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا نَطْمَعُ اَنْ يَّغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطٰيٰنَا͏ٓ اَنْ كُنَّا͏ٓ اَوَّلَ الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝٥١ؕࣖ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."

ayahs.ar: وَاَوْحَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلٰي مُوْسٰٓي اَنْ اَسْرِ بِعِبَادِيْٓ اِنَّكُمْ مُّتَّبَعُوْنَ ۝٥٢
ayahs.tr: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
[And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
And indeed, they are enraging us,
And indeed, we are a cautious society... "
So We removed them from gardens and springs
And treasures and honorable station -
Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
So they pursued them at sunrise.

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا تَرَا࢜ءَ الْجَمْعٰنِ قَالَ اَصْحٰبُ مُوْسٰٓي اِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُوْنَ ۝٦١ۚ
ayahs.tr: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَلَّاۚ اِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّيْ سَيَهْدِيْنِ ۝٦٢
ayahs.tr: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."

ayahs.ar: فَاَوْحَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلٰي مُوْسٰٓي اَنِ اضْرِبْ بِّعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَؕ فَانْفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيْمِ ۝٦٣ۚ
ayahs.tr: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
And We advanced thereto the pursuers.
And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
Then We drowned the others.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝٦٧
ayahs.tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
And recite to them the news of Abraham,

ayahs.ar: اِذْ قَالَ لِاَبِيْهِ وَقَوْمِهٖ مَا تَعْبُدُوْنَ ۝٧٠
ayahs.tr: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا نَعْبُدُ اَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عٰكِفِيْنَ ۝٧١
ayahs.tr: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا بَلْ وَجَدْنَا͏ٓ اٰبَا࢜ءَنَا كَذٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُوْنَ ۝٧٤
ayahs.tr: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
You and your ancient forefathers?

ayahs.ar: فَاِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّيْٓ اِلَّا رَبَّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۝٧٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيْٓ اَطْمَعُ اَنْ يَّغْفِرَ لِيْ خَطِيْ࢜ـَٔتِيْ يَوْمَ الدِّيْنِ ۝٨٢ؕ
ayahs.tr: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِيْ حُكْمًا وَّاَلْحِقْنِيْ بِالصّٰلِحِيْنَ ۝٨٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.

ayahs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ لِّيْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْاٰخِرِيْنَ ۝٨٤ۙ
ayahs.tr: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.
And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

ayahs.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِاَبِيْٓ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّا࢜لِّيْنَ ۝٨٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ مَالٌ وَّلَا بَنُوْنَ ۝٨٨ۙ
ayahs.tr: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا مَنْ اَتَي اللّٰهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيْمٍ ۝٨٩ؕ
ayahs.tr: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."
And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,

ayahs.ar: وَقِيْلَ لَهُمْ اَيْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُوْنَ ۝٩٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship

ayahs.ar: مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِؕ هَلْ يَنْصُرُوْنَكُمْ اَوْ يَنْتَصِرُوْنَ ۝٩٣ؕ
ayahs.tr: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?"
So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators
And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
They will say while they dispute therein,

ayahs.ar: تَاللّٰهِ اِنْ كُنَّا لَفِيْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۝٩٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: "By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error
When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
And no one misguided us except the criminals.
So now we have no intercessors
And not a devoted friend.

ayahs.ar: فَلَوْ اَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝١٠٢
ayahs.tr: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝١٠٣
ayahs.tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
The people of Noah denied the messengers

ayahs.ar: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ نُوْحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۝١٠٦ۚ
ayahs.tr: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا͏ٓ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍۚ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۝١٠٩ۚ
ayahs.tr: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
So fear Allah and obey me."
They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِيْ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ ۝١١٢ۚ
ayahs.tr: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?

ayahs.ar: اِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّيْ لَوْ تَشْعُرُوْنَ ۝١١٣ۚ
ayahs.tr: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
And I am not one to drive away the believers.
I am only a clear warner."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا لَىِٕنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهِ يٰنُوْحُ لَتَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْمَرْجُوْمِيْنَ ۝١١٦ؕ
ayahs.tr: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.

ayahs.ar: فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَّنَجِّنِيْ وَمَنْ مَّعِيَ مِنَ الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝١١٨
ayahs.tr: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."

ayahs.ar: فَاَنْجَيْنٰهُ وَمَنْ مَّعَهٗ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُوْنِ ۝١١٩ۚ
ayahs.tr: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝١٢١
ayahs.tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
'Aad denied the messengers

ayahs.ar: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ هُوْدٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۝١٢٤ۚ
ayahs.tr: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا͏ٓ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍۚ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۝١٢٧ؕ
ayahs.tr: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,
And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally?
And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
So fear Allah and obey me.
And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
Provided you with grazing livestock and children
And gardens and springs.

ayahs.ar: اِنِّيْٓ اَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ ۝١٣٥ؕ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا سَوَا࢜ءٌ عَلَيْنَا͏ٓ اَوَعَظْتَ اَمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ مِّنَ الْوٰعِظِيْنَ ۝١٣٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
And we are not to be punished."

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَاَهْلَكْنٰهُمْؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝١٣٩
ayahs.tr: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
Thamud denied the messengers

ayahs.ar: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ صٰلِحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۝١٤٢ۚ
ayahs.tr: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا͏ٓ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍۚ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۝١٤٥ؕ
ayahs.tr: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
Within gardens and springs
And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
So fear Allah and obey me.
And do not obey the order of the transgressors,

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيْنَ يُفْسِدُوْنَ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُوْنَ ۝١٥٢
ayahs.tr: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

ayahs.ar: مَا͏ٓ اَنْتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَاۚۖ فَاْتِ بِاٰيَةٍ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ ۝١٥٤
ayahs.tr: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَّلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُوْمٍ ۝١٥٥ۚ
ayahs.tr: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَمَسُّوْهَا بِسُوْ࢜ءٍ فَيَاْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ ۝١٥٦
ayahs.tr: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.

ayahs.ar: فَاَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝١٥٨
ayahs.tr: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
The people of Lot denied the messengers

ayahs.ar: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ لُوْطٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۝١٦١ۚ
ayahs.tr: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا͏ٓ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍۚ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۝١٦٤ؕ
ayahs.tr: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
Do you approach males among the worlds

ayahs.ar: وَتَذَرُوْنَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ مِّنْ اَزْوَاجِكُمْؕ بَلْ اَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ عٰدُوْنَ ۝١٦٦
ayahs.tr: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا لَىِٕنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهِ يٰلُوْطُ لَتَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِيْنَ ۝١٦٧
ayahs.tr: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."
So We saved him and his family, all,
Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
Then We destroyed the others.

ayahs.ar: وَاَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَّطَرًاۚ فَسَا࢜ءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِيْنَ ۝١٧٣
ayahs.tr: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝١٧٤
ayahs.tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
The companions of the thicket denied the messengers

ayahs.ar: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ ۝١٧٧ۚ
ayahs.tr: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا͏ٓ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍۚ اِنْ اَجْرِيَ اِلَّا عَلٰي رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۝١٨٠ؕ
ayahs.tr: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

ayahs.ar: اَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُوْنُوْا مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِيْنَ ۝١٨١ۚ
ayahs.tr: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
And weigh with an even balance.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشْيَا࢜ءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ مُفْسِدِيْنَ ۝١٨٣ۚ
ayahs.tr: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
And fear He who created you and the former creation."
They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا͏ٓ اَنْتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَاِنْ نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الْكٰذِبِيْنَ ۝١٨٦ۚ
ayahs.tr: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.

ayahs.ar: فَاَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ ۝١٨٧ؕ
ayahs.tr: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."

ayahs.ar: فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَاَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيْمٍ ۝١٨٩
ayahs.tr: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةًؕ وَمَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝١٩٠
ayahs.tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down
Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -
In a clear Arabic language.
And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهُمْ اٰيَةً اَنْ يَّعْلَمَهٗ عُلَمٰ࢜و͏ٔ͏ُا بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَا࢜ءِيْلَ ۝١٩٧ؕ
ayahs.tr: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners

ayahs.ar: فَقَرَاَهٗ عَلَيْهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ مُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝١٩٩ؕ
ayahs.tr: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals.

ayahs.ar: لَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ بِهٖ حَتّٰي يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْاَلِيْمَ ۝٢٠١ۙ
ayahs.tr: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
So for Our punishment are they impatient?
Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
And then there came to them that which they were promised?

ayahs.ar: مَا͏ٓ اَغْنٰي عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يُمَتَّعُوْنَ ۝٢٠٧ؕ
ayahs.tr: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا͏ٓ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ اِلَّا لَهَا مُنْذِرُوْنَ ۝٢٠٨ࣗۖۛ
ayahs.tr: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
And the devils have not brought the revelation down.
It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.

ayahs.ar: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَتَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِيْنَ ۝٢١٣ۚ
ayahs.tr: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.

ayahs.ar: وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ۝٢١٥ۚ
ayahs.tr: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers.

ayahs.ar: فَاِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ اِنِّيْ بَرِيْ࢜ءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ ۝٢١٦ۚ
ayahs.tr: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
Who sees you when you arise
And your movement among those who prostrate.
Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: هَلْ اُنَبِّي͏ٔ͏ُكُمْ عَلٰي مَنْ تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيٰطِيْنُ ۝٢٢١ؕ
ayahs.tr: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
They descend upon every sinful liar.
They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;

ayahs.ar: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّهُمْ فِيْ كُلِّ وَادٍ يَّهِيْمُوْنَ ۝٢٢٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
And that they say what they do not do? -

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللّٰهَ كَثِيْرًا وَّانْتَصَرُوْا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوْاؕ وَسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْٓا اَيَّ مُنْقَلَبٍ يَّنْقَلِبُوْنَ ۝٢٢٧ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
